demo_chips: How much does a kitchen remodel cost?
How do I get a free estimate?
fallback: Great question - I don't want to guess on that one. You can reach Rockland Design Factory at (845) 682-3076 or rocklanddesignfactory@gmail.com, or leave your name and email here and we'll follow up.

faqs.q: Can I buy cabinets without a remodeling contract?
faqs.a: Yes. You can buy kitchen cabinets and use your own contractor or installer. We confirm final dimensions, cabinet specifications, delivery, and installation responsibility in writing.
Our workmanship carries a 2-year warranty, and cabinetry carries a 10-year warranty.

faqs.q: How long does a remodel take?
faqs.a: Kitchen and bathroom remodeling typically take about 20 days each. Timing varies with scope, materials, approvals and site conditions, and we'll confirm your project's schedule before construction.

pricing.summary: Full kitchen remodels run $65,000-$110,000, and high-end kitchens (double island, natural stone) run $120,000-$220,000. Cabinets only, with no installation, start at $6,000. Full bathroom remodels run $21,000-$35,000, and a primary bath with a wet room runs $28,000-$55,000. Every final price is set by a written estimate after a consultation - and project estimates are free.
